descriptions.w3d_set_color_from_message_801697b4: Adjusts a secondary-base pointer, converts the four message floats to colour bytes (scaled, quantized store), marks the object changed and counts the update.
descriptions.w3d_open_stream_801e6b1c: Gets the sample volume from the sound manager, converts it to a byte (quantized store) and opens a stereo or mono stream for the object, storing the handle.
descriptions.w3d_set_render_mode_8026b334: Changes the render mode if different: refreshes visible text in mode 1, otherwise refreshes the alpha fields from the colour alpha (quantized load); reapplies tint.
